what: Proposed orchestrator-specific failure message can read count when no grep ran
scenario_or_breakage: If an orchestrator manifest file is missing, set -u can abort on an unset count for the first missing row, or report a stale count after an earlier row, instead of preserving the intended missing=1 lint diagnostics
suggested_fix: Initialize count=0 before the file-exists guard, or use the generic missing-file message when the file is absent; also render defaults with ${expected_count:-1} and ${count:-0}
